clips.title: The story
paras: At Saldean's Farm, the Saldeans hold Westfall's only homestead not completely overrun and abandoned to the Defias Brotherhood. Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma keep the farmhouse as a rare safe haven amid the region's turmoil.

The Saldean family stayed on their soil as neighboring lands fell to banditry and mechanical sabotage. Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma still offer hot food and a kind word to travelers. Rogue harvest golems deployed across the plains plague their fields, so the family keeps close to the farmhouse walls.

Stormwind's crown has largely neglected Westfall, leaving law enforcement thin. A handful of Sentinel Hill and Stormwind guards patrol the periphery, but the Saldeans rely chiefly on their own grit and help from passing travelers. Salma's famous Westfall stew and goretusk liver pie, and the shelter of the farmhouse, offer small comforts against the Defias threat.
